title: 動物の先生
lead: ねこ・くま・うさぎ・ふくろうなど、動物の先生が授業をする場面12点です。園や教室の掲示物、学習資料に使えます。
subject_en: Original kawaii animal characters as teachers, each ONE animal standing upright in teacher clothes and doing a classroom task, centred, friendly. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
